units.source_text: 内大臣听说近江君想当尚侍，不禁哈哈大笑。

en.t: When the Minister of the Interior heard that Omi no Kimi wanted to become Naishi no Kami, he could not help bursting into loud laughter.

units.source_text: 有一天他去探望女御，乘便问道：“近江君在哪里？

en.t: One day, when he went to visit the lady-in-waiting, he asked in passing, "Where is Omi no Kimi?

units.source_text: 叫她到这里来！”便召唤她。

en.t: Have her come here!" and so he summoned her.

units.source_text: 近江君在里面高声应道：“来——了——！”立刻走到父亲面前。

en.t: From inside, Omi no Kimi answered loudly, "I am coming!" and immediately went before her father.

units.source_text: 内大臣对她说道：“我看了你替女御服务的模样，方知你入朝当女官，原来是非常合格的。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said to her, "After seeing how you serve the lady-in-waiting, I realize that you are actually very well suited to enter court as a female official.

units.source_text: 你想当尚侍，何不早对我说？”说时态度很认真。

en.t: If you wanted to become Naishi no Kami, why did you not tell me sooner?" He spoke with a very serious manner.

units.source_text: 近江君不胜欢喜，答道：“我本想恳求父亲，但我确信女御等一定会替我转达。

en.t: Omi no Kimi was overjoyed and replied, "I had meant to ask you myself, Father, but I was sure that the lady-in-waiting and the others would speak for me.

units.source_text: 可是现在听说，这个职位已经另有人占去了，我就好比做梦发了大财，

en.t: But now I hear that someone else has already taken the post, so I feel as if I became rich in a dream,

units.source_text: 醒来只得手摸胸膛，垂头丧气。”这番话说得异常爽快流畅。

en.t: only to wake and find myself with nothing but a hand on my chest, utterly dejected." She said all this with remarkable ease and fluency.

units.source_text: 内大臣实在想笑出来，好容易忍住了，对她说道：“凡事不肯直说，是最不好的习惯。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior truly wanted to laugh aloud, but barely managed to hold it in and said to her, "Refusing to speak plainly about anything is the worst habit of all.

units.source_text: 倘早些儿对我说了，我一定首先推荐你。

en.t: If you had told me earlier, I would certainly have recommended you first.

units.source_text: 太政大臣家的女儿身份虽然高贵，但只要我恳切申请，皇上无不准许。

en.t: Although the Chancellor's daughter is of noble rank, if I petition earnestly, there is nothing the Emperor would refuse.

units.source_text: 现在还来得及，你且写一篇申请文，字要写得端正。

en.t: There is still time now, so write a petition, and make sure your handwriting is neat.

units.source_text: 皇上看见其中所附长歌富有情趣，一定会录用你。

en.t: When the Emperor sees that the long poem attached to it has such refined charm, he will surely appoint you.

units.source_text: 因为皇上最喜爱富有情趣的东西。”他花言巧语地欺骗她。

en.t: After all, the Emperor loves things of refined charm more than anything." He deceived her with these honeyed words.

units.source_text: 这不像是父亲的话，实在太恶劣了。

en.t: These were hardly the words of a father, and were truly cruel.

units.source_text: 近江君信以为真，答道：“和歌呢，我虽然很不高明，却也会做。

en.t: Omi no Kimi believed him completely and answered, "As for waka, although I am not very skilled, I can compose them.

units.source_text: 至于那重要的申请文，最好由父亲出面，代我申请。

en.t: But as for the important petition, it would be best if you, Father, came forward and applied on my behalf.

units.source_text: 那么我就好托父亲之福了。”她搓着手恳求。

en.t: Then I could benefit from your good offices, Father." She rubbed her hands together as she pleaded.

units.source_text: 躲在帷屏背后等处的侍女听了这些话，肚子里好笑得要死。

en.t: The attendants hiding behind curtains, screens, and the like heard these words and found them so funny inside that they could hardly bear it.

units.source_text: 忍不住笑的人，溜出室外去痛快地笑一场。

en.t: Those who could not hold back their laughter slipped outside the room and laughed to their hearts' content.

units.source_text: 女御也脸红了，觉得讨厌之极。

en.t: The lady-in-waiting also blushed and felt utterly mortified.

units.source_text: 后来内大臣说：“烦恼的时候，只要找近江君。

en.t: Later, the Minister of the Interior said, "When I am troubled, all I need is to call for Omi no Kimi.

units.source_text: 一看到她，万种忧闷都消解了。”他只把她当作消忧解闷的笑料。

en.t: The moment I see her, every kind of gloom melts away." He treated her merely as a laughingstock to relieve his own melancholy.

units.source_text: 世人议论纷纷，有的人说：“内大臣为欲掩羞，故意用开玩笑的态度对待她。”

en.t: People in society talked about it in all sorts of ways, and some said, "The Minister of the Interior treats her jokingly on purpose in order to hide his shame."
